scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman sit peacefully at a simple wooden table with bread, while people gesture in disagreement around a plentiful feast visible through an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a quiet meal of dry bread with feasting accompanied by strife, as in Proverbs 17:1.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a plainly dressed man points toward a downcast man working beside baskets. Three men sit near an open chest of cloth and vessels, holding small bags and cups, with fields and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 17:2: a wise servant gains authority over a shameful son and shares an inheritance among brothers.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient workshop, a metalworker tends a pot of silver beside a glowing furnace holding gold, while a man nearby rests a hand over his heart and looks toward the light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the refining of silver and gold to Proverbs 17:3, which says Yahweh tests hearts.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers into the ear of an eagerly attentive seated man while two villagers look on with concern in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 17:4's picture of eager attention to false and spiteful speech.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in worn clothing kneels beside a broken clay jar and spilled grain on a village street as a richly dressed man points and laughs; an older man watches the mocker with a stern expression.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a poor person's misfortune and another person's mockery, reflecting Proverbs 17:5's warning against mocking the poor and rejoicing at calamity.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling child places a flower wreath on an elderly man's head while a younger man sits beside them, smiling. Vines, pottery and a distant hillside village surround the family.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative family scene reflects the proverb's picture of grandchildren as the crown of the aged and fathers as the glory of their children.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in a cream tunic spreads his arms as he speaks to skeptical listeners, while a richly dressed, crowned prince gestures toward other men and crosses his fingers behind his back.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 17:7's contrast between excellent speech from a fool and lying lips from a prince.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler in ancient robes looks at a sparkling red gemstone in his open hand beside an open gate, with people and baskets of produce in a sunlit market beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the present as a precious stone in its possessor’s eyes and the prosperity described in Proverbs 17:8.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man draws a cloth over a broken clay vessel beside a downcast companion. Behind them, one person whispers to another while two men stand turned apart.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 17:9: covering a fault is pictured alongside seeking friendship, while whispering and separated companions suggest the harm of repeating a matter.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man points to a stone while a younger craftsman listens with a chisel in hand. Behind them, another man speaks to a man who stands with folded arms and turns away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a receptive listener with someone resistant to correction, echoing Proverbs 17:10's comparison of rebuke and blows.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a startled man pushes against a toppled wooden barrier while a stern man in a dark robe approaches carrying a staff.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of an evil man seeking rebellion and a cruel messenger sent against him in Proverbs 17:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler on a rocky path looks back at a growling bear outside a dark den, while a smiling man behind him struggles with a teetering stack of fruit baskets in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts a man encountering a bear whose cubs are gone with a fool acting recklessly, echoing Proverbs 17:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man recoils as a loaf falls between him and a scowling man who holds out his hand. A dark rain cloud hangs over the stone house behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness repaid with harm and trouble lingering over the house, reflecting Proverbs 17:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two villagers face each other with open hands beside water pouring through a gap in an earthen irrigation bank, with trees, fields, and a distant village behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the release of water through a bank with the beginning of strife and the choice to leave contention before a quarrel breaks out.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit town-gate court, a seated judge waves one man away while pointing at another, who is held by guards and carries a bundle. An older man protests beside the departing man, a woman gestures toward the restrained man, and a tilted balance rests before the judge.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative courtroom scene reflects Proverbs 17:15's paired injustices: justifying the wicked and condemning the just, both abhorrent to the LORD.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a seated teacher offers a rolled parchment to a richly dressed young man who holds silver coins in one hand and admires a jeweled ornament in the other.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the verse's question about having the price to acquire wisdom while lacking the heart for it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man offers a bowl of food and puts an arm around a weary man seated beside a storm-damaged stone home, as sunlight breaks through clouds over a hillside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a friend offering comfort and practical help in adversity, reflecting Proverbs 17:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a smiling man clasps hands across a table with an older man while a concerned man watches behind them; a tied pouch rests on the table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the verse’s warning about a person lacking understanding who pledges surety for a friend.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two adults argue in a sunlit ancient village courtyard beside a tall stone gateway whose upper wall is breaking apart, with stones falling onto rubble.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the verse’s strife and raised gate to the danger of destruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient clothing lies in a muddy roadside ditch and points toward a startled traveler; a basket of fruit rests on the road above, with stone buildings and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the fall into trouble and the fruit beyond reach to Proverbs 17:20, which speaks of a deceitful heart finding no good and a perverse tongue falling into evil.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits with his head in his hand in a sunlit stone courtyard while a younger man walks away, raising one hand dismissively.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the sorrow of a father whose son is a fool in Proverbs 17:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling woman offers a bowl of herbs and rests a hand on the shoulder of a downcast seated woman. A dry plant stands beside them, and a flowering green plant grows nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the refreshment of a merry heart, likened to medicine, with the dryness associated with a broken spirit in Proverbs 17:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone town gate, a man passes a small pouch to a seated judge while a worried man waits nearby. A balance on the judge’s table tilts to one side.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a secret bribe and tilted scales evokes Proverbs 17:23 and the perversion of justice.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Under a tree on a rocky hillside, a seated man listens closely to an elderly man while another man stands nearby, shading his eyes as he looks toward a distant sunlit valley and mountains.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts wisdom close before a person of understanding with the wandering gaze toward the ends of the earth in Proverbs 17:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful mother rests a hand on the shoulder of a grieving seated father as their adult son walks away with one hand raised. An overturned clay jar spills water across their stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 17:25's grief and bitterness experienced by the parents of a foolish son.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a stern seated official points toward a calm, richly dressed man while a guard behind the man raises a staff. Concerned townspeople watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 17:26 and its warning against punishing the righteous and striking princes for their uprightness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man listens quietly with his chin resting on his hand while another seated man speaks with animated gestures. Pottery, flowering plants, olive branches and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to Proverbs 17:27 by portraying restrained speech and a calm spirit through attentive listening.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly with his chin resting on his hand as four neighbors converse around him in a sunlit stone courtyard, with vines, pottery, and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 17:28: a person who keeps silent can be regarded as wise and perceptive.
